subject: SIG follow-up: PR ownership, CI gate logs, and secrets rotation evidence
messages:
From: Acme Assessment <assessor@acme-assess.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Pamela Santos <pamela.santos@finservco.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: evidence request - PR chain, CI gates, secrets

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier today. As part of FinServCo's SIG submission we need a few discrete artifacts to verify your secure SDLC controls. Can you please provide the following items (or point us to a single bundle)?

- A PR ownership matrix showing who can approve merges for primary repos (code reviewer roles + escalation path).
- CI gate snapshots and logs for the last two weekly release pipelines (we only need redacted logs showing gate pass/fail and who triggered).
- Evidence of secrets rotation for KMS/ephemeral tokens covering Q2 2025 (audit report or export).
- Short note on how emergency/rollback changes are authorized and tracked.

If you can share links + any attachments by end of week that would keep the SIG timeline on track for FinServCo. Pam, please chime in if you need any additional context.

Regards,
Stefan Becker
Acme Assessment
assessor@acme-assess.com

--

Team — forwarding assessor ask from Stefan. Timeline: they want artifacts by Friday EOD (their timezone). Quick assignments below: please reply-all with what you can provide + any caveats.

Irene: can you pull the PR ownership matrix (role mapping + recent approver history) and confirm if any repos have delegated approvers?
Jordan: can you export CI gate snapshots for the weekly release pipelines (2025-06-02 and 2025-06-09) and redact PII/keys? A short README about what each log contains would help.
Soojin: can you produce the Q2 secrets rotation audit (KMS & ephemeral token rotation), and a one-paragraph description of emergency rollback authorization steps?

I'll collect and upload to the Drive folder and respond to Stefan. If anything needs security redaction or legal review, flag it immediately.

Thanks — Tessa

Redwood Inference

Tessa — attaching CI artifacts. Notes:

- Attachments: ci-gate-snapshot-2025-06-02.log (redacted), ci-gate-snapshot-2025-06-09.log (redacted), pr-ownership-matrix.csv (initial export).
- Redaction: removed usernames that map to personal emails; replaced with role tags (e.g., reviewer:platform-eng).
- CI gating: the snapshots include the gate outcome, timestamp, pipeline trigger id, and approver id for manual gates. Automated unit/integration gates are present with pass/fail codes.
- CI retention: logs are archived for 90 days; the snapshots are exports from the archival store.

Irene — the PR matrix CSV is a raw export; happy to pivot formatting if assessor needs a different view.

Jordan

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG follow-up: evidence request - PR chain, CI gates, secrets

Attaching the secrets rotation audit and a short remediation note. Summary:

- Attachment: secret-rotation-audit-2025Q2.pdf (redacted). Contains active KMS key rotation timestamps, rotation owner, and key ids; ephemeral token rotation schedule with sampling evidence.
- Rotation policy: quarterly rotation for long-lived KMS keys; ephemeral tokens rotate per-deployment via CI with TTLs <= 12 hours.
- Emergency/rollback flow: rollback changes require two approvals from the Deploy Authority group (one must be from a different team than the deploy owner). Rollbacks are initiated via an annotated PR with a rollback tag and the CI rollforward playbook triggers a canary rollback. All rollbacks create an incident ticket and are logged in the change management ledger (internal Jira).

Caveats: audit PDF includes key ids that must remain redacted for external consumption; I've replaced the full key ids with truncated ids in the view we will share.

Soojin
Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
